Definition: properly, to roll flat, i.e. prepare (a road); also to revolve, i.e. weigh (mentally)
BiblicalUsage: Pâlaç is to weigh, to make level, to smooth a path. The proverb says ponder the path of thy feet and let all thy ways be established, and Isaiah says the way of the just is uprightness, and Thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God weighs my path before He asks me to walk it: He makes it level, and my part is to ponder where my feet are going.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
